checks.statement: Eliminating the printed governing equations gives D=kappa^2+4*omega_z^2 and the corrected coordinates.
Every symbol and test parameter is bound to the printed supplement or the frozen claim configuration.

Stationarity and unit-norm residuals separate the corrected and printed expressions far above roundoff.
Focused tests require corrected branches to pass and the printed branches to fail.
The current isolated claim run completed with bound inputs and no forbidden source access.
